Louis Clark Conducting The Royal Philharmonic Orchestra – Hooked on Classics

Original U.S. RCA Victor stereo LP, catalog AFL1-4194, released in 1981.

A popular classical-crossover album featuring orchestral medleys of well-known works by Bach, Mozart, Tchaikovsky, Mendelssohn, Beethoven, Handel, Brahms, Wagner and others, arranged and conducted by Louis Clark with the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra.

Condition:
Vinyl: VG+ visually graded – retains strong gloss with light surface/handling marks visible under direct lighting.
Cover: VG+ – attractive front and back presentation with light shelf/edge wear and a crease/bend at the upper-right corner. Please review all photos as they are part of the condition description.

Label: RCA Victor
Catalog: AFL1-4194
Year: 1981
Country: USA
Format: 12" Vinyl LP
Speed: 33 RPM
Stereo

Includes:

  • Hooked on Classics Parts 1 & 2
  • Hooked on Romance
  • Hooked on Classics Part 3
  • Hooked on Bach
  • Hooked on Tchaikovsky
  • Hooked on a Song
  • Hooked on Mozart
  • Hooked on Mendelssohn
  • Hooked on a Can Can
